limitations: E6 has no eligible prior ranking observations; 8 correct timing rows do not complete model validation.
E9 stage-service has zero covered priors and uses structural ordering; do not attribute its results to calibrated stage-service prediction.
The NTT protocol placement label is ambiguous; the physical model uses explicit natural output order. Interpret rows as recorded natural-order NTT commands, not an out-of-place NTT API claim.
Regret is measured against a finite 16-candidate pool per workload, not global optimality.
Offline replay is not online tuning wall time. Invocation wall includes setup and CPU checks; CUDA-event kernel timing excludes them.
Measurement reports lack embedded UUID; same-card provenance additionally relies on the recorded queue environment and pre/post exclusive-GPU guards.
